_comment: Pooled profile for code/07c_pool_sites.py. Copy to sites/pooled.json (gitignored), or let ./run_pooled.sh --members a,b,c write it. `members` are site profile names whose stages 0-7 have run on this machine; their order sets the anonymized letters (first = Site A). Nothing else is read: the pooled run uses only the members' stage-7 outputs.
